config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves POST /api/concierge, and the origin the generated embed snippets point at. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the concierge answer call
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the concierge answer call. The answer streams over a free-first LLM chain that can fail over across providers, so the default leaves room for one slow rung.

config.label: Timeout in milliseconds for fetching a page that concierge_ask grounds its answer in
config.description: Timeout in milliseconds for fetching a page that concierge_ask grounds its answer in. Separate from the answer timeout so a slow site cannot consume the whole call.
